form.en: seven-character song-style poem (a long story in verse)

text_note.zh: 本文用通行的写法。数据库原文有几处不同：“鞞鼓”作“鼙鼓”，“劒阁”作“剑阁”，“西宫南苑”作“西宫南内”，“宫叶满阶红不埽”作“落叶满阶红不扫”，“棃”作“梨”，“展转”作“辗转”，“求之徧”作“求之遍”，“裴回”作“徘徊”，“寂莫”作“寂寞”，“緜緜”作“绵绵”。其中多数只是古今字形不同，意思一样。另外，有的版本“天旋日转”作“天旋地转”，“飘飖”作“飘飘”。
text_note.en: This page uses the commonly taught text. The database text differs in a few places: it has older or variant forms of several characters (for pí gǔ, jiàn gé, lí, zhǎn zhuǎn, biàn, pái huái, jì mò and mián mián), and two real wording differences: "West Palace, South Garden" where the taught text has "West Palace, South Palace" (nán nèi), and "palace leaves fill the steps" where the taught text has "fallen leaves fill the steps" (luò yè). Most of these are just old and new ways of writing the same word. Some editions also have tiān xuán dì zhuǎn for tiān xuán rì zhuǎn, and piāo piāo for piāo yáo.

readings.zh: 重：读 zhòng，看重的意思。不读 chóng。第二十六句“不重生男重生女”的两个“重”也读 zhòng。
readings.en: zhòng: to value. Not chóng. Both zhòng in line 26, "not prizing sons but prizing daughters", are read the same way.

readings.zh: “早朝”的“朝”读 cháo，指上朝。“一朝”“朝朝暮暮”的“朝”读 zhāo，指早晨或一天。
readings.en: In zǎo cháo, "early court", it is read cháo, to hold court. In yī zhāo, "one day", and zhāo zhāo mù mù, "every morning and evening", it is read zhāo.

readings.zh: 乘：读 shèng，这里是名词，一辆车叫一乘。
readings.en: shèng: a noun here, one chariot.

readings.zh: 骑：现在统一读 qí。古代当名词“一人一马”讲时读 jì，有的书仍注 jì。
readings.en: qí: today it is always read qí. In old usage, as a noun meaning a rider and horse, it was read jì, and some books still give jì.

readings.zh: 薄：在“日色薄”里读 bó，暗淡、微弱的意思。
readings.en: bó: in rì sè bó it is read bó, meaning faint, weak.

readings.zh: 监：读 jiàn。“阿监”是宫中的女官。
readings.en: jiàn: ā jiàn is a woman official of the palace.

readings.zh: 思：现在读 sī。古时当名词“心思、愁思”讲可读 sì。
readings.en: sī: read sī today. In old usage, as a noun meaning thoughts or sorrow, it could be read sì.

readings.zh: 挑：读 tiǎo，把灯芯挑起来。
readings.en: tiǎo: to pick up the lamp wick.

readings.zh: 教：读 jiāo，“让、使”的意思。“转教”“但教”的“教”也读 jiāo。
readings.en: jiāo: to make, to let. It is read the same in zhuǎn jiāo and dàn jiāo.

readings.zh: 参差：读 cēn cī，这里是“差不多”的意思。
readings.en: cēn cī: here it means almost, about the same.

readings.zh: 觉：读 jué，睡醒的意思。一说读 jiào。
readings.en: jué: to wake up. Some read it jiào.

readings.zh: 阑干：读 lán gān，泪水纵横的样子。
readings.en: lán gān: tears running in streaks.
hé: here it means a box.

readings.zh: 重：读 chóng，再一次的意思。
为：读 wéi，做、成为的意思。

glosses.zh: 汉皇：汉朝的皇帝。这里其实是指唐玄宗李隆基。唐朝诗人写本朝的事，常借“汉”来说“唐”。
glosses.en: hàn huáng: the Han emperor. It really means the Tang emperor Xuanzong. Tang poets often said "Han" when they meant their own Tang dynasty.

glosses.zh: 重色：看重美色，喜欢美女。
glosses.en: zhòng sè: to care a lot about beauty, to love beautiful women.

glosses.zh: 倾国：美得能让一个国家倾倒的女子，就是绝世美人。
glosses.en: qīng guó: a woman so beautiful she could topple a kingdom; a beauty beyond compare.

glosses.zh: 御宇：统治天下。宇，天下。
glosses.en: yù yǔ: to rule the land. Yǔ means the whole world under heaven.

glosses.zh: 初长成：刚刚长大成人。
glosses.en: chū zhǎng chéng: had just grown up.

glosses.zh: 深闺：女子住的内室，在家里很深的地方，外人看不到。
glosses.en: shēn guī: the inner rooms where young women lived, deep inside the house, out of sight.

glosses.zh: 丽质：美丽的容貌和气质。
glosses.en: lì zhì: beauty of face and bearing.

glosses.zh: 难自弃：不会被埋没，迟早会被发现。
glosses.en: nán zì qì: could not be left unnoticed; sooner or later it would be found.

glosses.zh: 一朝：有一天。
glosses.en: yī zhāo: one day.

glosses.zh: 君王侧：皇帝身边。侧，旁边。
glosses.en: jūn wáng cè: by the emperor's side.

glosses.zh: 回眸：回头看。眸，眼珠。
glosses.en: huí móu: to turn and look back. Móu is the pupil of the eye.

glosses.zh: 百媚生：显出各种各样的美。
glosses.en: bǎi mèi shēng: a hundred kinds of charm appear.

glosses.zh: 六宫：皇后和妃子们住的地方，就是后宫。
glosses.en: liù gōng: the six palaces, where the empress and consorts lived; the inner palace.

glosses.zh: 粉黛：擦脸的白粉和画眉的黑颜料，这里指后宫里化着妆的美女。
glosses.en: fěn dài: face powder and eyebrow paint. Here it means the made-up beauties of the palace.

glosses.zh: 无颜色：失去光彩，被比下去了。
glosses.en: wú yán sè: to lose all color; to be outshone.

glosses.zh: 赐浴：皇帝让她去洗浴。这是一种特别的宠爱。
glosses.en: cì yù: the emperor granted her a bath there, a special favor.

glosses.zh: 华清池：骊山脚下华清宫里的温泉池，在今天陕西西安临潼。
glosses.en: huá qīng chí: the Huaqing hot-spring pool at the foot of Mount Li, in today's Lintong, Xi'an, Shaanxi.

glosses.zh: 凝脂：凝固的油脂，又白又滑，用来形容皮肤白嫩。
glosses.en: níng zhī: set fat or cream, white and smooth; used to describe soft, fair skin.

glosses.zh: 侍儿：服侍人的宫女。
glosses.en: shì ér: a maid who waits on someone.

glosses.zh: 娇无力：娇柔得没有力气。
glosses.en: jiāo wú lì: so soft and delicate she has no strength.

glosses.zh: 承恩泽：得到皇帝的宠爱。恩泽，像雨露一样的恩惠。
glosses.en: chéng ēn zé: to receive the emperor's favor. Ēn zé means kindness that falls like rain and dew.

glosses.zh: 云鬓：像云一样又多又蓬松的鬓发。鬓，耳边的头发。
glosses.en: yún bìn: hair at the temples, thick and soft like clouds.

glosses.zh: 金步摇：一种金首饰，插在头上，上面挂着珠玉，走一步摇一下。
glosses.en: jīn bù yáo: a gold hairpin hung with beads and jade that swayed with every step.

glosses.zh: 芙蓉帐：绣着荷花的帐子。芙蓉，荷花。
glosses.en: fú róng zhàng: bed curtains embroidered with lotus flowers. Fú róng is the lotus.

glosses.zh: 度春宵：度过春天的夜晚。
glosses.en: dù chūn xiāo: to spend the spring night.

glosses.zh: 苦短：只恨太短。
glosses.en: kǔ duǎn: painfully short.

glosses.zh: 早朝：皇帝清早上朝，和大臣们商量国家大事。
glosses.en: zǎo cháo: the early-morning court, where the emperor met his ministers to run the country.

glosses.zh: 承欢：讨皇帝欢心。
glosses.en: chéng huān: to keep the emperor happy.

glosses.zh: 侍宴：陪皇帝饮酒吃饭。
glosses.en: shì yàn: to keep the emperor company at feasts.

glosses.zh: 闲暇：空闲的时候。
glosses.en: xián xiá: free time.

glosses.zh: 春从春游：春天跟着皇帝去游春。
glosses.en: chūn cóng chūn yóu: in spring she went along on every spring outing.

glosses.zh: 夜专夜：每天晚上都只有她陪着皇帝。专，独占。
glosses.en: yè zhuān yè: every night was hers alone. Zhuān means to have all to oneself.

glosses.zh: 佳丽：美女。
glosses.en: jiā lì: beautiful women.

glosses.zh: 三千：形容很多，不是准确的数字。
glosses.en: sān qiān: three thousand; it just means very many, not an exact count.

glosses.zh: 金屋：华丽的宫室。借用汉武帝小时候说要“造金屋给阿娇住”的故事。
glosses.en: jīn wū: a golden house, a splendid chamber. It recalls the story of Emperor Wu of Han, who as a boy promised to build a golden house for his cousin A Jiao.

glosses.zh: 玉楼：华丽的楼阁。
glosses.en: yù lóu: a jade tower, a splendid building.

glosses.zh: 醉和春：醉意和春意融在一起。
glosses.en: zuì hé chūn: her tipsiness blended with the warmth of spring.

glosses.zh: 姊妹弟兄：姐妹兄弟。姊，姐姐。
glosses.en: zǐ mèi dì xiōng: sisters and brothers. Zǐ means elder sister.

glosses.zh: 列土：分封土地，得到爵位。杨贵妃的三个姐姐都被封为国夫人，她的族兄杨国忠后来当了宰相。
glosses.en: liè tǔ: to be given land and titles. Yang Guifei's three elder sisters were made Ladies of states, and her cousin Yang Guozhong later became chief minister.

glosses.zh: 可怜：可爱、令人羡慕。不是今天“值得同情”的意思。
glosses.en: kě lián: enviable, lovely. It does not mean "pitiful" here, as it does today.

glosses.zh: 门户：家门，指杨家。
glosses.en: mén hù: the family gate, meaning the Yang family.

glosses.zh: 遂令：于是使得。
glosses.en: suì lìng: and so it made.

glosses.zh: 不重生男重生女：不看重生男孩，反而看重生女孩。因为女儿可能像杨贵妃一样，让全家富贵。
glosses.en: bù zhòng shēng nán zhòng shēng nǚ: not prizing sons but prizing daughters, since a daughter might bring the whole family wealth and rank, as Yang Guifei did.

glosses.zh: 骊宫：骊山上的华清宫。
glosses.en: lí gōng: the Huaqing Palace on Mount Li.

glosses.zh: 青云：高空中的云。
glosses.en: qīng yún: clouds high in the blue sky.

glosses.zh: 仙乐：像仙界一样美妙的音乐。
glosses.en: xiān yuè: music as lovely as that of the immortals.

glosses.zh: 凝丝竹：乐声悠长，好像凝住了一样。丝竹，弦乐器和管乐器，泛指音乐。
glosses.en: níng sī zhú: the music lingers as if frozen in the air. Sī zhú, silk and bamboo, means string and wind instruments, that is, music.

glosses.zh: 尽日：一整天。
glosses.en: jìn rì: all day long.

glosses.zh: 看不足：看不够。
glosses.en: kàn bù zú: could never see enough.

glosses.zh: 渔阳：唐代的一个郡，在今天北京、天津一带。安禄山就是从这一带起兵造反的。
glosses.en: yú yáng: a Tang district around today's Beijing and Tianjin. An Lushan launched his rebellion from this area.

glosses.zh: 鼙鼓：军队里用的小鼓，这里指战争。
glosses.en: pí gǔ: small army drums; here they stand for war.

glosses.zh: 惊破：惊散、打断。
glosses.en: jīng pò: to startle and shatter, to break off.

glosses.zh: 霓裳羽衣曲：唐代宫廷里有名的乐舞。霓裳，彩虹一样的衣裙；羽衣，羽毛做的衣服。据说杨贵妃很会跳这支舞。
glosses.en: ní cháng yǔ yī qǔ: the Rainbow Skirt and Feather Coat, a famous Tang court song and dance. Yang Guifei is said to have danced it beautifully.

glosses.zh: 九重城阙：指京城长安。九重，一层又一层，形容宫门很多；城阙，城楼。
glosses.en: jiǔ chóng chéng què: the capital, Chang'an. Jiǔ chóng means gate after gate; chéng què means city towers.

glosses.zh: 烟尘生：烟尘升起，指战火来了。
glosses.en: yān chén shēng: smoke and dust rise; war has come.

glosses.zh: 千乘万骑：成千上万的车马。乘，一辆车；骑，一人一马。
glosses.en: qiān shèng wàn qí: thousands of chariots and horsemen. Shèng is one chariot; qí is one rider and his horse.

glosses.zh: 西南行：往西南走，逃向蜀地（今天的四川）。
glosses.en: xī nán xíng: to go southwest, fleeing toward Shu, today's Sichuan.

glosses.zh: 翠华：用翠鸟羽毛装饰的旗子，是皇帝专用的仪仗。
glosses.en: cuì huá: a banner decorated with kingfisher feathers, used only for the emperor.

glosses.zh: 行复止：走了又停，停了又走。
glosses.en: xíng fù zhǐ: moving, then stopping, then moving again.

glosses.zh: 都门：京城的城门。
glosses.en: dū mén: the gate of the capital.

glosses.zh: 百余里：一百多里。马嵬坡在长安西边一百多里。
glosses.en: bǎi yú lǐ: a hundred li and more. Mawei Slope lies a little over a hundred li west of Chang'an. A li is about half a kilometer.

glosses.zh: 六军：皇帝的军队。
glosses.en: liù jūn: the six armies, the emperor's own troops.

glosses.zh: 不发：不肯出发前进。
glosses.en: bù fā: refused to march on.

glosses.zh: 无奈何：没有办法。
glosses.en: wú nài hé: nothing could be done.

glosses.zh: 宛转：痛苦挣扎的样子。一说是依依不舍的样子。
glosses.en: wǎn zhuǎn: twisting in pain. Another reading: clinging on, unwilling to part.

glosses.zh: 蛾眉：像蚕蛾触须一样细长弯弯的眉毛，常用来代指美女，这里指杨贵妃。
glosses.en: é méi: eyebrows long and curved like a moth's feelers; a way of saying "a beauty". Here it means Yang Guifei.

glosses.zh: 马前死：死在军队的马前。史书说她是被勒死的。
glosses.en: mǎ qián sǐ: died before the horses. History books say she was strangled.

glosses.zh: 花钿：用金银珠宝做成花朵形状的首饰。
glosses.en: huā diàn: flower-shaped ornaments of gold, silver and gems.

glosses.zh: 委地：掉落在地上。
glosses.en: wěi dì: dropped on the ground.

glosses.zh: 翠翘：像翠鸟尾巴上长羽毛的首饰。
glosses.en: cuì qiáo: an ornament shaped like a kingfisher's long tail feathers.

glosses.zh: 金雀：雀鸟形状的金钗。
glosses.en: jīn què: a gold hairpin shaped like a bird.

glosses.zh: 玉搔头：玉簪，一种插头发的玉首饰。
glosses.en: yù sāo tóu: a jade hairpin.

glosses.zh: 掩面：用手捂住脸。
glosses.en: yǎn miàn: to cover one's face with the hands.

glosses.zh: 血泪相和流：眼泪和血混在一起流下来，形容伤心到了极点。
glosses.en: xuè lèi xiāng hé liú: tears and blood flow together; grief beyond bearing.

glosses.zh: 黄埃：黄色的尘土。
glosses.en: huáng āi: yellow dust.

glosses.zh: 散漫：四处飘散。
glosses.en: sàn màn: spreading everywhere.

glosses.zh: 萧索：冷冷清清，很凄凉。
glosses.en: xiāo suǒ: bleak and desolate.

glosses.zh: 云栈：高入云端的栈道。栈道，在悬崖上凿洞、架木板修成的路。
glosses.en: yún zhàn: plank roads high in the clouds, built by fixing wooden boards into holes cut in cliffs.

glosses.zh: 萦纡：弯弯曲曲，绕来绕去。
glosses.en: yíng yū: winding round and round.

glosses.zh: 剑阁：剑门关，在今天四川剑阁县，是进入蜀地的险要关口。
glosses.en: jiàn gé: Jianmen Pass, in today's Jiange County, Sichuan, a steep gateway into Shu.

glosses.zh: 峨嵋山：就是峨眉山，在今天的四川。玄宗逃往成都并没有经过峨眉山，这里是泛指蜀地的山。
glosses.en: é méi shān: Mount Emei in Sichuan. Xuanzong did not actually pass it on his way to Chengdu; here it simply stands for the mountains of Shu.

glosses.zh: 旌旗：各种旗子。
glosses.en: jīng qí: banners and flags.

glosses.zh: 日色薄：阳光暗淡无力。
glosses.en: rì sè bó: the sunlight is thin and pale.

glosses.zh: 蜀江：蜀地的江水。蜀，今天的四川一带。
glosses.en: shǔ jiāng: the rivers of Shu, the land around today's Sichuan.

glosses.zh: 圣主：对皇帝的尊称，这里指唐玄宗。
glosses.en: shèng zhǔ: the sage ruler, a respectful name for the emperor; here Xuanzong.

glosses.zh: 朝朝暮暮：每天早上和晚上，从早到晚。
glosses.en: zhāo zhāo mù mù: every morning and every evening.

glosses.zh: 行宫：皇帝出门在外时住的宫室。
glosses.en: xíng gōng: a palace where the emperor stays while traveling.

glosses.zh: 伤心色：让人伤心的颜色。
glosses.en: shāng xīn sè: a color that makes the heart ache.

glosses.zh: 闻铃：听到铃声。传说玄宗在栈道上听到雨中的铃声，想念贵妃，写了一支曲子《雨霖铃》。
glosses.en: wén líng: hearing bells. Legend says Xuanzong heard bells ringing in the rain on the plank roads, missed Yang Guifei, and wrote a tune called "Bells in the Rain".

glosses.zh: 肠断：肠子都断了，形容伤心到极点。
glosses.en: cháng duàn: the gut breaking; the deepest grief.

glosses.zh: 天旋日转：天地转动，比喻局势大变。这里指唐军收复了长安。
glosses.en: tiān xuán rì zhuǎn: heaven and sun turn round; the situation changes completely. Here: the Tang army has won back Chang'an.

glosses.zh: 回龙驭：皇帝的车驾掉头回京。龙驭，皇帝坐的车。
glosses.en: huí lóng yù: the emperor's carriage turns back for the capital. Lóng yù, the dragon carriage, is the emperor's.

glosses.zh: 到此：到了这里，指马嵬坡。
glosses.en: dào cǐ: arriving here, at Mawei Slope.

glosses.zh: 踌躇：犹豫，走来走去拿不定主意。
glosses.en: chóu chú: to hesitate, to linger.

glosses.zh: 马嵬坡：地名，在今天陕西兴平，杨贵妃死在这里。
glosses.en: mǎ wéi pō: Mawei Slope, in today's Xingping, Shaanxi, where Yang Guifei died.

glosses.zh: 玉颜：像玉一样美的容颜。
glosses.en: yù yán: a face as lovely as jade.

glosses.zh: 空死处：只剩下她死去的地方。空，白白地、只有。
glosses.en: kōng sǐ chù: only the empty place where she died. Kōng means merely, in vain.

glosses.zh: 相顾：你看我，我看你。
glosses.en: xiāng gù: to look at one another.

glosses.zh: 沾衣：泪水打湿了衣服。
glosses.en: zhān yī: tears wet their clothes.

glosses.zh: 信马：任凭马自己走，不去管它，形容心情低落。
glosses.en: xìn mǎ: to let the horse go where it will; a sign of low spirits.

glosses.zh: 池苑：宫里的池塘和园林。
glosses.en: chí yuàn: the palace ponds and gardens.

glosses.zh: 依旧：和从前一样。
glosses.en: yī jiù: just as before.

glosses.zh: 太液：太液池，宫中的池子。
glosses.en: tài yè: Taiye Pool, a lake in the palace.

glosses.zh: 未央：未央宫，本来是汉朝的宫殿，这里借指唐朝的宫殿。
glosses.en: wèi yāng: Weiyang Palace, a Han palace, used here to mean the Tang palace.

glosses.zh: 如何：怎么能。
glosses.en: rú hé: how could.

glosses.zh: 泪垂：流下眼泪。
glosses.en: lèi chuí: tears fall.

glosses.zh: 梧桐：一种高大的树，叶子很大，秋天落叶。古诗里常用来写秋天的冷清。
glosses.en: wú tóng: a tall tree with big leaves that fall in autumn. Old poems use it to suggest autumn loneliness.

glosses.zh: 西宫南内：西宫，指太极宫；南内，指兴庆宫。玄宗回京后先住在兴庆宫，后来被迁到太极宫。
glosses.en: xī gōng nán nèi: the West Palace (the Taiji Palace) and the South Palace (the Xingqing Palace). After coming back, Xuanzong lived first in the Xingqing Palace and was later moved to the Taiji Palace.

glosses.zh: 红不扫：红色的落叶没有人扫。
glosses.en: hóng bù sǎo: the red leaves lie unswept.

glosses.zh: 梨园弟子：玄宗在宫中“梨园”亲自教出来的乐工和演员。后来人们把唱戏的演员叫作“梨园弟子”。
glosses.en: lí yuán dì zǐ: the musicians and performers Xuanzong trained himself in the Pear Garden of the palace. Later, opera performers came to be called by this name.

glosses.zh: 椒房：皇后住的宫殿，墙上用花椒和泥涂抹，又暖又香。这里泛指后宫。
glosses.en: jiāo fáng: the pepper rooms, the empress's palace, whose walls were plastered with mud mixed with Sichuan pepper for warmth and scent. Here it means the inner palace.

glosses.zh: 阿监：宫里管事的女官。
glosses.en: ā jiàn: the women officials who ran the palace.

glosses.zh: 青娥：年轻美丽的容颜。
glosses.en: qīng é: young and beautiful looks.

glosses.zh: 夕殿：傍晚的宫殿。
glosses.en: xī diàn: the palace hall at dusk.

glosses.zh: 思悄然：默默地、忧伤地想着心事。
glosses.en: sī qiǎo rán: thinking quietly and sadly.

glosses.zh: 孤灯挑尽：古时的油灯要不时把灯芯挑一挑，灯才亮。灯芯都挑完了，说明夜已经很深了。
glosses.en: gū dēng tiǎo jìn: the wick of an oil lamp had to be pulled up now and then to keep it bright. Trimming it until none was left means the night was very late.

glosses.zh: 未成眠：还没有睡着。
glosses.en: wèi chéng mián: still not asleep.

glosses.zh: 迟迟：慢慢的，形容夜晚过得很慢。
glosses.en: chí chí: slow; the night seems to crawl.

glosses.zh: 钟鼓：夜里报时用的钟和鼓。
glosses.en: zhōng gǔ: the bells and drums that told the hours of the night.

glosses.zh: 初长夜：夜晚刚开始变长，指秋天的夜。
glosses.en: chū cháng yè: the nights just starting to grow long; autumn nights.

glosses.zh: 耿耿：明亮的样子。
glosses.en: gěng gěng: shining bright.

glosses.zh: 星河：银河。
glosses.en: xīng hé: the river of stars, the Milky Way.

glosses.zh: 欲曙天：天快要亮了。曙，天刚亮。
glosses.en: yù shǔ tiān: the sky about to grow light. Shǔ is dawn.

glosses.zh: 鸳鸯瓦：一仰一俯、成对扣在一起的屋瓦，像一对鸳鸯。
glosses.en: yuān yāng wǎ: roof tiles laid in pairs, one up and one down, like a pair of mandarin ducks.

glosses.zh: 霜华重：霜花结得很厚。
glosses.en: shuāng huá zhòng: the frost lies thick.

glosses.zh: 翡翠衾：绣着翡翠鸟的被子。翡翠鸟常常成双成对。衾，被子。
glosses.en: fěi cuì qīn: a quilt embroidered with kingfishers, birds that go in pairs. Qīn is a quilt.

glosses.zh: 谁与共：和谁一起盖呢？
glosses.en: shuí yǔ gòng: who is there to share it?

glosses.zh: 悠悠：长久、遥远。
glosses.en: yōu yōu: long and far.

glosses.zh: 经年：过了一年又一年。
glosses.en: jīng nián: year after year.

glosses.zh: 不曾：从来没有。
glosses.en: bù céng: never once.

glosses.zh: 临邛：地名，在今天四川邛崃。
glosses.en: lín qióng: a place in today's Qionglai, Sichuan.

glosses.zh: 鸿都客：客居在京城的人。鸿都本来是汉朝洛阳的宫门名，这里借指长安。
glosses.en: hóng dū kè: a guest staying in the capital. Hongdu was a palace gate in Han-dynasty Luoyang, used here for Chang'an.

glosses.zh: 精诚：真诚到极点的心意。
glosses.en: jīng chéng: perfect sincerity.

glosses.zh: 致：招来。
glosses.en: zhì: to call up, to bring.

glosses.zh: 为感：因为被……感动。
glosses.en: wèi gǎn: because people were moved by.

glosses.zh: 辗转思：翻来覆去地想念，睡不着觉。
glosses.en: zhǎn zhuǎn sī: tossing and turning with longing, unable to sleep.

glosses.zh: 方士：会法术的人，这里就是那位道士。
glosses.en: fāng shì: a master of magic arts; here, the Daoist priest.

glosses.zh: 殷勤觅：尽心尽力地寻找。
glosses.en: yīn qín mì: to search with great care and effort.

glosses.zh: 排空驭气：推开空气，驾着云气飞行。
glosses.en: pái kōng yù qì: to push through the sky and ride the air.

glosses.zh: 求之遍：到处都找遍了。
glosses.en: qiú zhī biàn: searched everywhere for her.

glosses.zh: 穷：走到尽头。
glosses.en: qióng: to go to the very end.

glosses.zh: 碧落：天空。这是道家的说法。
glosses.en: bì luò: the blue sky, a Daoist name for heaven.

glosses.zh: 黄泉：地底下，传说人死后去的地方。
glosses.en: huáng quán: the Yellow Springs, deep under the earth, where the dead were said to go.

glosses.zh: 茫茫：空旷辽远，什么也看不清。
glosses.en: máng máng: vast and empty, nothing to be seen.

glosses.zh: 仙山：神仙住的山。传说海上有蓬莱等仙山。
glosses.en: xiān shān: a mountain where immortals live. Legend placed such mountains, like Penglai, out in the sea.

glosses.zh: 虚无缥缈：若有若无，隐隐约约，看不真切。
glosses.en: xū wú piāo miǎo: there and not there, hazy and dim.

glosses.zh: 玲珑：精巧好看。
glosses.en: líng lóng: finely made, delicate.

glosses.zh: 五云：五彩的云。
glosses.en: wǔ yún: clouds of five colors.

glosses.zh: 绰约：姿态柔美。
glosses.en: chuò yuē: graceful and gentle.

glosses.zh: 仙子：仙女。
glosses.en: xiān zǐ: fairy women, female immortals.

glosses.zh: 字太真：名叫太真。杨贵妃进宫前做过女道士，道号就叫“太真”。
glosses.en: zì tài zhēn: named Taizhen. Before entering the palace, Yang Guifei had been a Daoist nun, and Taizhen was her Daoist name.

glosses.zh: 参差是：差不多就是她。参差，相近、差不多。
glosses.en: cēn cī shì: almost certainly her. Cēn cī here means close to, about the same.

glosses.zh: 金阙：金色的宫殿。
glosses.en: jīn què: a golden palace.

glosses.zh: 西厢：西边的厢房。
glosses.en: xī xiāng: the west wing.

glosses.zh: 叩玉扃：敲玉做的门。叩，敲；扃，门。
glosses.en: kòu yù jiōng: to knock on the jade door. Kòu is to knock; jiōng is a door.

glosses.zh: 转教：转告，让人再去传话。
glosses.en: zhuǎn jiāo: to have someone pass the word along.

glosses.zh: 小玉：仙女的侍女的名字，借用了传说中的人物。
glosses.en: xiǎo yù: Xiaoyu, the name of a fairy maid, borrowed from old legends.

glosses.zh: 双成：也是仙女侍女的名字，传说是西王母身边的侍女董双成。
glosses.en: shuāng chéng: Shuangcheng, another fairy maid; legend makes her Dong Shuangcheng, a maid of the Queen Mother of the West.

glosses.zh: 闻道：听说。
glosses.en: wén dào: heard it said that.

glosses.zh: 汉家天子使：汉家皇帝派来的使者。这里也是借汉说唐。
glosses.en: hàn jiā tiān zǐ shǐ: an envoy sent by the Han emperor; again, Han stands for Tang.

glosses.zh: 九华帐：绣着许多花样的华美帐子。
glosses.en: jiǔ huá zhàng: splendid bed curtains embroidered with many flowers.

glosses.zh: 揽衣：拿起衣服披上。
glosses.en: lǎn yī: to pick up and throw on a robe.

glosses.zh: 徘徊：来回地走。
glosses.en: pái huái: to pace back and forth.

glosses.zh: 珠箔：珍珠串成的帘子。
glosses.en: zhū bó: a curtain of strung pearls.

glosses.zh: 银屏：镶着银的屏风。
glosses.en: yín píng: a silver-inlaid screen.

glosses.zh: 逦迤：一个接一个，连续不断。
glosses.en: lǐ yǐ: one after another, in a long row.

glosses.zh: 半偏：歪在一边。
glosses.en: bàn piān: tilted to one side.

glosses.zh: 新睡觉：刚刚睡醒。觉，醒来。
glosses.en: xīn shuì jué: just woken up. Jué means to wake.

glosses.zh: 花冠：用花装饰的帽子。
glosses.en: huā guān: a cap decorated with flowers.

glosses.zh: 不整：没有戴整齐。
glosses.en: bù zhěng: not put on straight.

glosses.zh: 仙袂：仙女的衣袖。袂，袖子。
glosses.en: xiān mèi: a fairy's sleeves. Mèi is a sleeve.

glosses.zh: 飘飖举：飘飘地扬起来。
glosses.en: piāo yáo jǔ: lifting and fluttering.

glosses.zh: 犹似：还像。
glosses.en: yóu sì: still like, just as if.

glosses.zh: 玉容：美丽的脸。
glosses.en: yù róng: a lovely face.

glosses.zh: 寂寞：这里指神情凄凉、孤单。
glosses.en: jì mò: lonely and sad-looking.

glosses.zh: 阑干：眼泪纵横流淌的样子。
glosses.en: lán gān: tears running down in streaks.

glosses.zh: 梨花一枝春带雨：像春天里一枝带着雨珠的梨花。用来比喻她带泪的美丽样子。
glosses.en: lí huā yī zhī chūn dài yǔ: like a spray of pear blossoms in spring, wet with rain; a picture of her beauty in tears.

glosses.zh: 含情：心里满怀深情。
glosses.en: hán qíng: full of feeling.

glosses.zh: 凝睇：定定地看着。睇，看。
glosses.en: níng dì: to gaze steadily. Dì means to look.

glosses.zh: 谢：致意，托人表达感谢和问候。
glosses.en: xiè: to send thanks and greetings.

glosses.zh: 音容：声音和容貌。
glosses.en: yīn róng: voice and face.

glosses.zh: 渺茫：遥远模糊，找不到。
glosses.en: miǎo máng: far, faint and lost.

glosses.zh: 昭阳殿：汉朝的宫殿，汉成帝宠爱的赵飞燕住在这里。这里借指杨贵妃当年住的宫殿。
glosses.en: zhāo yáng diàn: the Zhaoyang Hall, a Han palace where Zhao Feiyan, the favorite of Emperor Cheng, lived. It stands here for Yang Guifei's old palace.

glosses.zh: 恩爱绝：恩爱断绝了。
glosses.en: ēn ài jué: the love is cut off.

glosses.zh: 蓬莱宫：蓬莱仙山上的宫殿，就是她现在住的地方。
glosses.en: péng lái gōng: a palace on the immortal mountain of Penglai, where she now lives.

glosses.zh: 日月长：日子过得很漫长。
glosses.en: rì yuè cháng: the days and months are long.

glosses.zh: 人寰：人间。
glosses.en: rén huán: the human world.

glosses.zh: 尘雾：尘土和雾气。
glosses.en: chén wù: dust and mist.

glosses.zh: 唯将：只拿。
glosses.en: wéi jiāng: can only take.

glosses.zh: 旧物：从前的东西，指当年皇帝送给她的信物。
glosses.en: jiù wù: old things; the keepsakes the emperor once gave her.

glosses.zh: 表：表达。
glosses.en: biǎo: to show, to express.

glosses.zh: 钿合：用金银宝石镶嵌的首饰盒。合，同“盒”。
glosses.en: diàn hé: a jewelry box inlaid with gold and gems. Hé here means a box.

glosses.zh: 寄将去：托人带回去。将，没有实际意思的助词。
glosses.en: jì jiāng qù: to send back with someone. Jiāng here adds no meaning of its own.

glosses.zh: 一股：钗有两股，留下其中一股。
glosses.en: yī gǔ: a hairpin has two prongs; she keeps one.

glosses.zh: 一扇：盒子有上下两半，留下其中一半。
glosses.en: yī shàn: the box has a lid and a base; she keeps one half.

glosses.zh: 擘：掰开，分开。
glosses.en: bò: to break apart.

glosses.zh: 合分钿：把镶嵌宝石的盒子分开。
glosses.en: hé fēn diàn: the inlaid box is split in two.

glosses.zh: 但教：只要让。
glosses.en: dàn jiāo: as long as.

glosses.zh: 金钿坚：像金子和宝钿一样坚固。
glosses.en: jīn diàn jiān: as firm as gold and inlay.

glosses.zh: 会相见：总会再见面。
glosses.en: huì xiāng jiàn: will surely meet again.

glosses.zh: 殷勤：情意恳切。
glosses.en: yīn qín: earnestly, with deep feeling.

glosses.zh: 重寄词：再托人带一段话。重，再。
glosses.en: chóng jì cí: to send one more message. Chóng means again.

glosses.zh: 誓：誓言，发誓说的话。
glosses.en: shì: a vow, a promise sworn.

glosses.zh: 两心知：只有两个人心里知道。
glosses.en: liǎng xīn zhī: known only to their two hearts.

glosses.zh: 七月七日：农历七月初七，七夕节。传说这天牛郎织女在天上相会。
glosses.en: qī yuè qī rì: the seventh day of the seventh lunar month, the Qixi festival, when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl are said to meet in the sky.

glosses.zh: 长生殿：华清宫里的一座宫殿。
glosses.en: cháng shēng diàn: the Hall of Long Life, a hall in the Huaqing Palace.

glosses.zh: 私语：悄悄话。
glosses.en: sī yǔ: whispered words.

glosses.zh: 比翼鸟：传说中的鸟，每只只有一只眼睛、一只翅膀，必须两只并在一起才能飞。
glosses.en: bǐ yì niǎo: a bird of legend with only one eye and one wing; it can fly only side by side with its mate.

glosses.zh: 连理枝：两棵树的枝干长到了一起。
glosses.en: lián lǐ zhī: branches of two trees that have grown into one.

glosses.zh: 天长地久：天和地存在得那么长久。
glosses.en: tiān cháng dì jiǔ: as lasting as heaven and earth.

glosses.zh: 有时尽：也有结束的时候。
glosses.en: yǒu shí jìn: will still one day come to an end.

glosses.zh: 恨：遗憾、伤心。不是“仇恨”的意思。
glosses.en: hèn: sorrow, regret. It does not mean hatred here.

glosses.zh: 绵绵：连绵不断。
glosses.en: mián mián: going on and on without a break.

glosses.zh: 无绝期：没有尽头。
glosses.en: wú jué qī: with no end.

translation.zh: 汉朝的皇帝（其实是唐玄宗）喜爱美色，一心想找一位绝世美人。
translation.en: The Han emperor (really the Tang emperor Xuanzong) loved beauty and longed for a woman lovely beyond compare.

translation.zh: 他做了多年皇帝，一直没有找到。
translation.en: He ruled the land for many years but could not find her.

translation.zh: 杨家有一个女儿，刚刚长大成人。
translation.en: The Yang family had a daughter who had just grown up.

translation.zh: 她住在深深的闺房里，外人都不认识她。
translation.en: She lived in the inner rooms, and no outsider knew her.

translation.zh: 她天生美丽，这样的美貌不会一直被埋没。
translation.en: Her beauty was a gift from heaven; it could not stay hidden.

translation.zh: 有一天，她被选进宫，来到皇帝身边。
translation.en: One day she was chosen to be at the emperor's side.

translation.zh: 她回头一笑，千娇百媚。
translation.en: When she turned and smiled, a hundred charms came alive.

translation.zh: 后宫里化着妆的美人，和她一比都失去了光彩。
translation.en: All the made-up beauties of the palace looked dull beside her.

translation.zh: 早春还有些冷，皇帝让她到华清池洗温泉。
translation.en: In the chill of early spring, the emperor let her bathe in the Huaqing Pool.

translation.zh: 滑润的温泉水，洗着她洁白细嫩的皮肤。
translation.en: The smooth warm spring water washed her skin, white and soft as cream.

translation.zh: 宫女扶她起来，她娇柔得没有一点力气。
translation.en: Maids helped her up; she was so delicate she seemed to have no strength.

translation.zh: 这正是她刚开始得到皇帝宠爱的时候。
translation.en: This was when she first won the emperor's favor.

translation.zh: 她鬓发如云，容颜如花，头上的金步摇轻轻摇动。
translation.en: Hair like clouds, a face like a flower, a gold hairpin swaying as she moved.

translation.zh: 在温暖的芙蓉帐里，她陪皇帝度过春天的夜晚。
translation.en: Inside the warm lotus curtains, they passed the spring nights together.

translation.zh: 只嫌春夜太短，太阳升得老高才起床。
translation.en: The spring nights felt far too short; they rose only when the sun was high.

translation.zh: 从此皇帝不再一早上朝处理国事。
translation.en: From then on, the emperor stopped holding court in the early morning.

translation.zh: 她讨皇帝欢心，陪皇帝饮宴，没有一点空闲。
translation.en: Pleasing him and serving at his feasts, she never had a free moment.

translation.zh: 春天陪他游春，夜夜都由她一个人陪伴。
translation.en: In spring she joined him on every outing; every night she alone was with him.

translation.zh: 后宫的美女有三千人，
translation.en: There were three thousand beauties in the palace,

translation.zh: 可是三千人的宠爱都集中在她一个人身上。
translation.en: but the love meant for three thousand fell on her alone.

translation.zh: 在华丽的宫室里打扮好，娇媚地陪皇帝过夜。
translation.en: Made up in a golden chamber, she kept him charming company through the night.

translation.zh: 玉楼上的宴会散了，她带着醉意，和春天一样温柔。
translation.en: When the feast in the jade tower ended, she was tipsy and warm as spring.

translation.zh: 她的姐妹兄弟都封了爵位，得了封地。
translation.en: Her sisters and brothers were all given titles and lands.

translation.zh: 杨家门庭光彩照人，真让人羡慕。
translation.en: How enviable it was: glory shone from the Yang family gate.

translation.zh: 于是天下做父母的，心思都变了，
translation.en: And so the hearts of parents everywhere changed:

translation.zh: 不再看重生男孩，反而看重生女孩。
translation.en: they no longer prized sons, but prized daughters.

translation.zh: 骊山上的宫殿高高耸入云霄，
translation.en: The palace on Mount Li rose high into the clouds,

translation.zh: 仙乐一样美妙的音乐随风飘送，到处都听得见。
translation.en: and music fit for immortals drifted on the wind, heard everywhere.

translation.zh: 舒缓的歌，柔美的舞，配着悠长的乐声，
translation.en: Slow songs and gentle dances moved to the lingering sound of strings and flutes,

translation.zh: 皇帝整天看着，怎么也看不够。
translation.en: and the emperor watched all day long and never had enough.

translation.zh: 忽然，渔阳的战鼓震天动地地响起来，
translation.en: Then the war drums of Yuyang came, shaking the earth,

translation.zh: 打断了宫中的霓裳羽衣曲。
translation.en: and shattered the Rainbow Skirt and Feather Coat dance.

translation.zh: 京城里烟尘滚滚，战火烧来了。
translation.en: Smoke and dust rose over the many-gated capital.

translation.zh: 皇帝带着成千上万的车马向西南逃去。
translation.en: Thousands of chariots and horsemen fled to the southwest.

translation.zh: 皇帝的翠羽旗摇摇晃晃，队伍走走停停。
translation.en: The emperor's kingfisher banner swayed; the column moved and stopped, moved and stopped.

translation.zh: 向西走出京城一百多里。
translation.en: They went west, a hundred li and more beyond the city gate.

translation.zh: 护驾的军队不肯再走，皇帝也没有办法，
translation.en: The army would march no farther, and the emperor was helpless.

translation.zh: 美丽的杨贵妃在军马前痛苦地死去。
translation.en: The lovely lady with moth-wing brows died in agony before the horses.

translation.zh: 她的花钿掉在地上，没有人去收拾，
translation.en: Her flower ornaments fell to the ground, and no one picked them up,

translation.zh: 还有翠翘、金雀钗和玉簪，也都散落在地。
translation.en: nor the kingfisher plumes, the golden-bird pins, the jade hairpins.

translation.zh: 皇帝捂着脸，救不了她。
translation.en: The emperor covered his face; he could not save her.

translation.zh: 回头再看，眼泪和血一起流下来。
translation.en: Looking back, he wept tears mixed with blood.

translation.zh: 黄色的尘土四处飘散，风冷冷清清地吹着。
translation.en: Yellow dust spread everywhere, and the wind blew cold and bleak.

translation.zh: 沿着高入云端、弯弯曲曲的栈道，登上剑阁。
translation.en: Along winding plank roads high in the clouds, they climbed to Jiange Pass.

translation.zh: 峨眉山下，很少有人走过。
translation.en: Below Mount Emei, few people passed.

translation.zh: 旗子失去了光彩，阳光也暗淡无力。
translation.en: The banners lost their color, and the sunlight was thin and pale.

translation.zh: 蜀地的江水碧绿，蜀地的山青翠，
translation.en: The rivers of Shu were green-blue, the mountains of Shu were green,

translation.zh: 皇帝从早到晚都在思念她。
translation.en: and from morning to night the emperor longed for her.

translation.zh: 在行宫里看见月亮，月色也让人伤心；
translation.en: In his traveling palace, even the moonlight looked heartbroken;

translation.zh: 夜雨里听到铃声，声声让人肝肠寸断。
translation.en: on rainy nights, the sound of bells broke his heart.

translation.zh: 局势大变，唐军收复了京城，皇帝的车驾往回走。
translation.en: Then the world turned again, and the emperor's carriage headed home.

translation.zh: 走到马嵬坡，他徘徊犹豫，不忍离开。
translation.en: Reaching that place, he lingered and could not bring himself to leave.

translation.zh: 在马嵬坡下的泥土里，
translation.en: In the earth below Mawei Slope,

translation.zh: 再也见不到她美丽的容颜，只剩下她死去的地方。
translation.en: her lovely face was nowhere to be seen; only the place where she died remained.

translation.zh: 皇帝和大臣们互相看着，泪水打湿了衣裳。
translation.en: The emperor and his ministers looked at one another, their clothes wet with tears.

translation.zh: 向东望着京城的城门，任由马儿慢慢走回去。
translation.en: Gazing east toward the capital, they let the horses carry them home.

translation.zh: 回到宫中，池塘园林都和从前一样，
translation.en: Back home, the ponds and gardens were all as before:

translation.zh: 太液池的荷花，未央宫的柳树，还是老样子。
translation.en: the lotuses of Taiye Pool, the willows of Weiyang Palace.

translation.zh: 荷花像她的脸，柳叶像她的眉，
translation.en: The lotus was like her face, the willow leaves like her brows.

translation.zh: 面对这些，怎么能不流泪呢？
translation.en: Facing all this, how could he keep from weeping?

translation.zh: 春风吹开桃花李花的夜晚，
translation.en: On spring nights, when the breeze opened the peach and plum blossoms,

translation.zh: 秋雨打落梧桐叶的时候，他都更加想念她。
translation.en: and in autumn, when rain knocked down the wutong leaves, he missed her all the more.

translation.zh: 他住的西宫和南内，长满了秋草；
translation.en: Autumn weeds grew thick in the West Palace and the South Palace;

translation.zh: 红色的落叶铺满台阶，也没有人打扫。
translation.en: red fallen leaves covered the steps, and no one swept them.

translation.zh: 当年梨园的乐工，都新添了白发；
translation.en: The Pear Garden musicians had new white hair;

translation.zh: 后宫的女官，年轻的容颜也老了。
translation.en: the women officials of the palace had lost their young looks.

translation.zh: 傍晚，萤火虫在宫殿里飞，他默默地想着心事。
translation.en: At dusk, fireflies drifted through the hall as he sat lost in sad thought.

translation.zh: 一盏孤灯的灯芯都挑完了，他还是睡不着。
translation.en: He trimmed the lone lamp until its wick was gone, and still he could not sleep.

translation.zh: 报时的钟鼓声慢慢地响，长长的秋夜才刚开始；
translation.en: The bells and drums tolled slowly; the long autumn night had only begun.

translation.zh: 银河闪闪发亮，天快要亮了。
translation.en: The Milky Way shone bright as the sky grew close to dawn.

translation.zh: 成对的鸳鸯瓦冰冷，上面结着厚厚的霜；
translation.en: The paired roof tiles were cold, thick with frost;

translation.zh: 绣着翡翠鸟的被子冰凉，谁来和他一起盖呢？
translation.en: the kingfisher quilt was cold. Who was there to share it?

translation.zh: 生死离别，已经过了一年又一年，
translation.en: Life and death had parted them, and year after year had passed,

translation.zh: 她的魂魄却从来没有到他的梦里来过。
translation.en: yet her spirit never once came into his dreams.

translation.zh: 有个从临邛来的道士，客居在京城，
translation.en: A Daoist priest from Linqiong was staying in the capital.

translation.zh: 他能用至诚的心意招来死者的魂魄。
translation.en: By perfect sincerity he could call up the spirits of the dead.

translation.zh: 人们被皇帝日夜思念、睡不着觉的心情感动，
translation.en: Moved by the emperor's sleepless longing,

translation.zh: 于是请这位方士尽心尽力地去寻找她。
translation.en: people asked the priest to search for her with all his heart.

translation.zh: 他推开天空，驾着云气，像闪电一样飞奔，
translation.en: He pushed through the sky and rode the air, racing like lightning.

translation.zh: 上天下地，到处都找遍了。
translation.en: Up to heaven, down into the earth, he searched everywhere.

translation.zh: 上到天的尽头，下到地底的黄泉，
translation.en: He went to the far end of the blue sky and down to the Yellow Springs,

translation.zh: 两个地方都空空荡荡，哪里也没有她。
translation.en: but both were vast and empty, and she was in neither.

translation.zh: 忽然听说海上有一座仙山，
translation.en: Then he heard of an island of immortals out in the sea,

translation.zh: 那座山在若有若无、隐隐约约的地方。
translation.en: a mountain floating somewhere in the haze, there and not there.

translation.zh: 山上精巧的楼阁被五彩祥云围绕，
translation.en: Its fine towers rose among clouds of five colors,

translation.zh: 里面住着很多体态柔美的仙女。
translation.en: and many graceful fairy women lived inside.

translation.zh: 其中有一位名叫太真，
translation.en: Among them was one named Taizhen,

translation.zh: 雪白的皮肤、花一样的容貌，差不多就是她。
translation.en: snow-white skin and a face like a flower: it must be her.

translation.zh: 道士来到金色宫殿的西厢，敲响玉做的门，
translation.en: The priest came to the west wing of the golden palace and knocked on the jade door,

translation.zh: 请侍女小玉去告诉双成，让她再去通报。
translation.en: asking the maid Xiaoyu to tell Shuangcheng, who would carry the word inside.

translation.zh: 听说是汉家天子派来的使者，
translation.en: Hearing that an envoy had come from the Han emperor,

translation.zh: 她在华美的帐子里从梦中惊醒。
translation.en: she woke with a start inside her flowered bed curtains.

translation.zh: 她披上衣服，推开枕头，起身走来走去，
translation.en: She threw on a robe, pushed the pillow aside, rose and paced,

translation.zh: 珠帘和银屏风一道接一道地打开。
translation.en: and pearl curtains and silver screens opened one after another.

translation.zh: 她刚刚睡醒，云一样的鬓发偏在一边，
translation.en: Her cloud of hair had slipped to one side, for she had just woken.

translation.zh: 花冠也没戴整齐，就走下堂来。
translation.en: Her flower cap askew, she came down from the hall.

translation.zh: 风吹着她仙衣的袖子，飘飘扬起，
translation.en: The wind lifted her fairy sleeves so they fluttered up,

translation.zh: 还像当年跳霓裳羽衣舞的样子。
translation.en: as if she were still dancing the Rainbow Skirt and Feather Coat dance.

translation.zh: 她美丽的脸上满是凄凉，泪水纵横，
translation.en: Her lovely face was lonely and sad, with tears streaming down,

translation.zh: 像一枝春天的梨花，沾着雨珠。
translation.en: like a spray of pear blossoms in spring, wet with rain.

translation.zh: 她含着深情，定定地望着，请使者替她谢过君王：
translation.en: Full of feeling, gazing steadily, she sent her thanks to the emperor:

translation.zh: “自从分别，你我的声音和容貌，都远得找不到了。
translation.en: "Since we parted, your voice and face and mine have been lost to each other.

translation.zh: 昭阳殿里的恩爱已经断绝，
translation.en: The love I knew in the Zhaoyang Hall has been cut off,

translation.zh: 我在蓬莱仙宫里，日子过得漫长。
translation.en: and here in the palace of Penglai, the days and months are long.

translation.zh: 回过头向下看人间，
translation.en: When I turn and look down at the human world,

translation.zh: 看不见长安，只看见一片尘雾。
translation.en: I cannot see Chang'an, only dust and mist.

translation.zh: 我只能拿从前的东西来表达深情，
translation.en: I can only use old keepsakes to show my love:

translation.zh: 请把这镶嵌的首饰盒和金钗带回去。
translation.en: please take this inlaid box and this gold hairpin back to him.

translation.zh: 金钗留下一股，盒子留下一半；
translation.en: I keep one prong of the pin and one half of the box;

translation.zh: 把金钗掰开，把盒子分开。
translation.en: I break the gold pin and split the inlaid box.

translation.zh: 只要我们的心像金子和宝钿一样坚定，
translation.en: As long as our hearts stay as firm as gold and inlay,

translation.zh: 无论在天上还是人间，总会再相见。”
translation.en: in heaven or on earth, we will meet again."

translation.zh: 临别时，她又恳切地托道士带一段话，
translation.en: At parting, she earnestly sent one more message,

translation.zh: 话里有一个誓言，只有她和皇帝两个人知道：
translation.en: and in it was a vow known only to their two hearts:

translation.zh: 七月七日那天，在长生殿里，
translation.en: on the seventh day of the seventh month, in the Hall of Long Life,

translation.zh: 半夜四下无人，两人说悄悄话的时候发誓说：
translation.en: at midnight, with no one near, they had whispered to each other:

translation.zh: “在天上，我们愿做比翼齐飞的鸟；
translation.en: "In heaven, may we be two birds that fly wing to wing.

translation.zh: 在地上，我们愿做长在一起的连理枝。”
translation.en: On earth, may we be two branches grown into one."

translation.zh: 天再长、地再久，也有结束的时候，
translation.en: Heaven and earth last long, yet one day they will end.

translation.zh: 这份遗憾却绵绵不断，永远没有尽头。
translation.en: But this sorrow goes on and on, and never ends.

background.zh: 这首诗写于唐宪宗元和元年（806年）冬天。那年白居易三十五岁，在盩厔（今天陕西西安的周至县）做县尉，是县里的一个小官。有一天，他和朋友陈鸿、王质夫到仙游寺游玩，聊起五十年前唐玄宗和杨贵妃的故事，大家都很感慨。王质夫请白居易把它写成诗，陈鸿又写了一篇文章《长恨歌传》。故事背后是安史之乱：755年安禄山起兵造反，第二年玄宗逃往蜀地，走到马嵬坡时，士兵逼他让杨贵妃死去。
background.en: This poem was written in the winter of 806. Bai Juyi was thirty-five and served as a minor county official in Zhouzhi, today's Zhouzhi County near Xi'an, Shaanxi. One day he visited Xianyou Temple with his friends Chen Hong and Wang Zhifu. They talked about the story of Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei from fifty years before, and all were deeply moved. Wang Zhifu asked Bai Juyi to turn it into a poem, and Chen Hong wrote a prose account of it. Behind the story is the An Lushan Rebellion. In 755 An Lushan rose in revolt. The next year Xuanzong fled toward Shu, and at Mawei Slope his soldiers forced him to have Yang Guifei put to death.

author_note.zh: 白居易（772—846），字乐天，号香山居士，唐代大诗人。他主张诗要关心现实，要写得明白好懂。传说他写完诗会念给不识字的老婆婆听，直到她听懂为止。《长恨歌》和《琵琶行》是他最有名的两首长诗。他还活着的时候，这首诗就已经传遍各地，连小孩子都会吟唱。
author_note.en: Bai Juyi (772–846), also called Letian, was a great Tang poet. He believed poems should care about real life and be easy to understand. Legend says he read each new poem to an old woman who could not read, and changed it until she understood. "The Song of Everlasting Sorrow" and "The Pipa Player" are his two most famous long poems. Even in his lifetime this poem had spread far and wide, and even children could chant it.

appreciation.zh: 这是一首很长的故事诗，可以分成四段来读。第一段（开头到“惊破霓裳羽衣曲”之前）写杨贵妃进宫，得到皇帝独一无二的宠爱，皇帝也因此不理朝政。第二段写战乱突然到来，皇帝逃往蜀地，在马嵬坡失去了她，一路上看月、听雨都是伤心。第三段写皇帝回到长安，宫里的荷花、柳树、落叶、孤灯、冷被子，处处让他想起她，夜夜睡不着。第四段最像童话：道士上天入地，终于在海上仙山找到她。她哭得像带雨的梨花，送回信物，说出两人在七夕夜里许下的誓言。诗里很多情节是诗人的想象。读这首诗，可以先把它当成一个动人的爱情故事；也可以想一想，一个皇帝只顾玩乐，给国家和自己都带来了多大的悲剧。一说这首诗主要是写爱情，一说主要是讽刺，也有人认为两者都有。最后两句“天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期”，把这份遗憾说得比天地还长，成了千古名句。
appreciation.en: This is a long story in verse, and it can be read in four parts. Part one, up to the war drums, tells how Yang Guifei came to the palace and won the emperor's whole heart, so that he stopped caring for the country. Part two: war suddenly arrives, the emperor flees toward Shu, and at Mawei Slope he loses her. On the road, the moon and the rain only bring him grief. Part three: back in Chang'an, the lotuses, willows, fallen leaves, lonely lamp and cold quilt all remind him of her, and he cannot sleep at night. Part four is like a fairy tale. A Daoist priest searches heaven and earth and at last finds her on an island of immortals. She weeps like pear blossoms in the rain, sends back keepsakes, and recalls the vow they made on the night of Qixi. Many of these scenes come from the poet's imagination. You can first read it as a moving love story. You can also think about how an emperor who cared only for pleasure brought disaster to his country and to himself. Some readers say the poem is mainly about love, others say it mainly criticizes the emperor, and some say it is both. The last two lines say this sorrow will last even longer than heaven and earth, and they have been famous ever since.
